The menu

Short menu, made fresh. Old-school Chicago deli classics, the Vienna Beef line done right, jerk chicken from the islands, and a bakery counter built around the Chicago Lunchroom Butter Cookie.

Wholistic Food! A small stamp marks items on our all-beef line — Vienna Beef hot dogs and Polish, our corned beef and pastrami. Item by item, not a slogan.
